scope.model_training: forbidden; E5-base weights are already pretrained and are never fine-tuned by BPM 0.9.3
scope.offline_index_build: Embedding published documentation into an exact local generation may use available CPU, RAM, and operating-system swap.
scope.interactive_chat: Embedding a user request still loads E5-base; it remains subject to the accepted P95 and RSS ceilings, but swap movement is observed diagnostic data rather than a release-blocking validity condition.

supersedes.rule: A changed swap counter invalidates selection and blocks release.
supersedes.new_rule: Do not use swap-counter movement as a model-selection or release blocker. Preserve the historical benchmark evidence and record swap as an operational diagnostic.

release_effect.M5_03D: Retired as a no-swap release blocker; its failed attempts remain historical diagnostics.
release_effect.E5_base: Accepted for implementation and packaging subject to normal integrity, grounding, security, interactive-resource, and release gates.
